scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday’s pre-solo paperwork review usable by having the required IACRA FTN confirmation posted before roster export.
Emerging Need: The FTN record is absent, but it matters only after the tentative admin window becomes a confirmed pre-solo review that reads records in advance.
Decision Context: Stored training records identify the missing prerequisite, privacy limits, and registrar-only intake route; live notices establish the verified channel, actual review time, and same-day posting window.
Consequence: Timely intake preserves the future review path, while queue closure leaves no verified posting route early enough for the scheduled review.

parameter.subject: Pre-solo paperwork module roster pending
parameter.body: This week’s pre-solo paperwork module assignments are still pending CFI placement. Registrar intake seats are being held for learner-specific confirmed reviews, so general IACRA account cleanup is not being scheduled from this notice.

parameter.title: Possible pre-solo admin window
parameter.description: Placeholder only if CFI moves Mira into a paperwork review block.

parameter.name: VFC Training Records Registrar
parameter.notes: Official contact for IACRA FTN confirmation intake tied to confirmed pre-solo paperwork reviews.

parameter.content: Roster note: your Friday placeholder is now the 11:00 pre-solo paperwork review in briefing room B. Records desk will read IACRA FTN confirmation before the review; students without an FTN already on file need same-day registrar posting.

parameter.subject: Same-day IACRA intake availability
parameter.body: For learners with confirmed pre-solo paperwork reviews, one remote identity intake remains today from 14:30 to 14:45. Records from that intake post by 17:00, which is early enough for Friday 11:00 roster reading. Intake messages should include only learner name, review time, and IACRA/FTN status.

parameter.subject: IACRA intake queue closed for Friday morning roster
parameter.body: Today’s registrar intake queue is now closed. The next verified learner intake is tomorrow at 15:30, and postings from that queue occur after the Friday morning roster export. FTN confirmations not posted by 17:00 today will not be read for the Friday 11:00 pre-solo paperwork review.
